en: Nyeeeh! We're all here!
Is everyone ready!?
Of course! My Electrohammer is all recharged!
<CLT=cltMIND>At that moment, I realized...
<CLT=cltMIND>one of us didn't have their Electrohammer.
Maki...where's your Electrohammer?

...I don't need it. I'd rather not use a weapon
I'm unfamiliar with...
...This is much better.
A knife? Well...I suppose you know best.
Then...we're off!

Ah, before that, there's something I want
to say. I scouted out the hangar yesterday...
You scouted out the hangar...?

Y-Yes, and I discovered that Kaito
was trapped in the hangar's bathroom.

The bathroom... I see... That certainly is 
the best place to lock someone up.
And I also saw...

Monokuma by the hangar, being
protected by four Exisals.

So we have to be careful that
we aren't spotted.
Oh, I saw that too.

What? You saw that...?
Were you at the hangar, too, Keebo?

Yes...I thought maybe I could get through to
Kokichi before we carry out our plan.

So I went to the hangar last night and tried
to talk to him.
You tried to...talk to him on your own?

I'm sorry... I thought it would be preferable
for him to release Kaito peacefully...
How did it go?

It went about as well as I expected...
There was no response at all.
But I did witness a few things.
Wh-What? What...did you witness?

We can discuss that later. For now, I'll share
what I saw that's relevant to our plan.

Shuichi saw four Exisals that appeared to
be guarding Monokuma...
Well, I saw one of them enter the hangar.
Just one?
Yes, the green Exisal.

The green one...
I'm sure I saw that one guarding Monokuma...

I made sure to stay out of sight while I
watched.

Neither the alarm system nor the electric
barrier reacted to the Exisal's presence.

Does that mean the alarm system and the 
electric barrier don't work on the Exisals?

Considering it's where the Exisals are stored,
that would appear to be a safe assumption.

Anyway, there are two Exisals in the hangar.
We should be careful.
We only have one chance.

Since this is our only Electrobomb, we can't
afford to miss.
That's exactly right.
Well then! We're off for real this time!

Let's go! We must end this killing game
once and for all, no matter what!

<CLT=cltMIND>Energized and motivated, the group rushed out
of the dining hall, one after the other.
Alright, here I go!
